note: DEFERRED WORK, not backlog increments. Prototype capabilities the corpus never saw, surfaced when the designers pushed 7661d29 and 491b392 (address book) after the capture at 7da4f70. They carry prototype-side evidence only. Each still needs the treatment every backlog increment had - a frontend-side page model, a both-sides diff, a type and band, and an adversarial verifier whose instruction is to refute it - before it earns a place in backlog.json. Do not let the build loop near this file.
deferredReason: The design of this area is still moving - both of these commits landed in the four days after the corpus was captured, and they are all address-book work. Verifying them now would buy findings that go stale again on the next design push. Revisit when the address-book design settles, or when the EUDPA-58 address-book programme needs them, whichever comes first.
revisitWhen: The designers stop pushing address-book changes to GB-notification-service.
EUDPA-58 reaches the point of needing the prototype's address model.
Sam asks for the verification pass that would promote these into backlog.json.

candidates.title: The prototype can add an address from inside the journey; the frontend can only pick from the book
candidates.detail: New consignment-add-address.html (145 lines), GET and POST registered per address section at routes.js:10910-10911 as ${section.path}/add-address. UK postcode-style typeahead lookup with a manual fallback, across four new partials (consignment-uk-add-address-fields, consignment-uk-manual-address-fields, consignment-uk-contact-fields, consignment-manual-address-fields). Actions are 'Save and select' and 'Save and return to address page'. The captured picker only had a footer button off to the global address book.

candidates.title: Addresses carry a 'uses' tagging model the frontend has no concept of
candidates.detail: New consignment-address-use-groups.js (origin-and-sender vs destination-and-receiver, plus a section-to-group map) and address-book-branch-uses.js (branch address split out of address-book-destination-uses.js). The add-address page renders a 'What can this address be used for?' checkbox group scoped to the section you arrived from, and consignment-add-address-uses.js pre-ticks the matching use. address-book-add-categories.js gained a Branch category and renamed the other two.

candidates.title: Place of origin uses a country typeahead where the other four pickers use address search
candidates.detail: isPlaceOfOriginPage swaps the address search for a country typeahead - 'Enter a country' / 'Enter each country that the consignment will travel through' (consignment-address-select.html:80-136). Rows carry data-address-country and country-search.js dispatches app-country-search:change to re-filter. Picker behaviour is no longer uniform across the five roles; the corpus saw one shape. Overlaps inc-060, which is scoped to the single picker.

candidates.title: The address book is journey-scoped, reachable inside a notification with a return path
candidates.detail: buildAddressBookHref (routes.js:6232) and routes.js:8298-8299 resolve /address-book under ${journeyBasePath}, and journey-form-actions.html derives its cancel href from journeyBasePath. The captured prototype treated the address book as a global page. Bears directly on the 'who owns the address book' question inc-039 raises, and on the EUDPA-58 address-book programme.

candidates.title: The addresses hub shows a success banner after an add or select round trip
candidates.detail: roles-and-addresses.html:30-38 renders a govukNotificationBanner after returning from an add or select. No finding covers hub feedback messaging at all.

candidates.title: Journey form actions split hub-return copy from overview-return copy
candidates.detail: journey-form-actions.html gained hubText and cancelText. cph-number, permanent-address, permanent-address-animals, contact-address-for-consignment and the picker all now pass 'Save and return to hub' / 'Cancel and return to hub' while the partial default stays 'return to overview'. Separately consignment-address-sections.js:72 reworded the hub's CPH section heading to 'County parish holding (CPH) number' - adjacent to inc-030 but a different string.

candidates.title: The address picker offers named save actions and a cancel link, not a single continue
candidates.detail: The picker's single 'Save and continue' became named action=continue / action=hub buttons plus a Cancel link (consignment-address-select.html:238-257). The frontend picker has one submit.

candidates.title: A second one-click copy shortcut, 'same as place of origin', for consignor or exporter
candidates.detail: consignment-address-sections.js canUseSameAsPlaceOfOrigin, roles-and-addresses.html:95-102, routes.js:2124/2144/10928, with scroll preservation in roles-and-addresses.js. inc-025 names only the consignee variant, so this is either a scope widening of inc-025 or a candidate in its own right - decide which before either is built.
